gripOrHq.title: Management Shake-Up
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Team Restructuring
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add one advancement counter to each of up to two installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Encryption Breakthrough
gripOrHq.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

gripOrHq.title: Bolter Cluster
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Holovid Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Holovid Campaign when you rez it. Take [1] from Holovid Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Holovid Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Encoder, Inc.
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Code gates cost [1] less to rez while Encoder, Inc. is rezzed. All code gates have an additional "End the run" subroutine after all other subroutines.

heapOrArchives.title: Chicago Branch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.

scoreArea.title: Genetics-Visionary Acquisition
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Research agendas is reduced by 1.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: The Shell Traders
discardCards.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

discardCards.title: Finders Keepers
discardCards.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

discardCards.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

discardCards.title: Panzer Run
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Sneak Preview
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

discardCards.title: Sneak Preview
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

discardCards.title: Swiss Bank Account
discardCards.rulesText: You may use the following abilities whenever you pay any cost or penalty. [T]: Gain [2]. [3], [T]: Gain [6]. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: Social Engineering
discardCards.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

discardCards.title: Invisibility
discardCards.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

discardCards.title: Sneak Preview
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

discardCards.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

discardCards.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. For each card stored in HQ, the Corp either pays [2] or discards that card.

scoreArea.title: Encryption Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

rig.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

ice.title: Code Corpse
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Dr. Dreff
root.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Twenty-Four-Hour Surveillance
root.rulesText: During runs on this fort, Runner cannot use bits from stealth sources.

root.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
root.rulesText: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

ice.title: D'Arc Knight
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.
